collection.title: Mercedes-Benz Citan Van (with Tailgate) 2013 to 2021 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mercedes-Benz Citan 2013 - 2021 requires a 23" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 21" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have rear wiper blades for this model, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
